headline: Building projects at HMLS, Bates, and BAIS, including playground, gym floor, roof, and HVAC work, plus leases at HMLS, SHS, and CMS.
summary: The agenda covers playground, gym floor, and roof plans at HMLS. It also covers the Bates roof project, HVAC at BAIS, and leases at HMLS, SHS, and CMS.
items: HMLS: playground, gym floor, and roof plans (rooftop units, boilers, generators)
